last.verdict: Big beat and a sharply raised profit outlook, but the stock rose only modestly.

reasons.label: Profit outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted earnings forecast lifted to $2.55–$2.65 a share, from $2.25–$2.45.

reasons.label: Strong sales growth
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 7.9% worldwide, with 4.2% more customer transactions.

reasons.label: Earnings crushed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $0.85 a share versus roughly $0.66 expected.

story: Starbucks' turnaround has built steadily. Same-store sales were up 4% in North America in the January report, and shares jumped. They rose 6.2% worldwide in April, with the full-year outlook raised, and 7.9% now, with the outlook raised again.
